d: Join us for the most magical sunrise experience in Ghatshila! In Travel Vlog EP 02, we wake up before dawn to discover the secret spot to watch the sun rise over the historic Suvarna Rekha River (the Golden River). You won't believe the incredible view from this hidden Ghatshila Sunrise Point. We also explore the ancient river rock formations and dive into the legendary history behind its golden name—is there still gold dust here? Watch till the end for essential Ghatshila Travel Tips!
